description: This file handles the upload, processing, and management of language packs and modules during the installation of SuiteCRM, a CRM software based on SugarCRM. It includes logic for uploading language zip files, verifying file types and sizes, unpacking language packs, and rendering the upload interface with associated scripts and styles.

classes.name: PackageManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing package downloads and operations during installation.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a package based on release ID.

classes.name: UploadFile
classes.description: A utility class to handle file uploads and validation.

methods.name: confirm_upload
methods.description: Checks if an uploaded file is valid.

methods.name: get_stored_filename
methods.description: Returns the temporary filename where the uploaded file is stored.

methods.name: final_move
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to its final location.
